title: Prefer standard gestures for standard remote actions

statement.en: Prefer standard remote gestures for standard tvOS actions.
statement.ja: tvOSのstandard actionにはstandard remote gestureを優先する。

conditions: Preserve familiar remote behavior in ordinary app use.
exceptions: Custom gestures can be appropriate during active gameplay.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Remotes experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
